about: Package weight and size averages per leaf category, given by the operator (never made up). A row: category_id, category_name, fields (low / central / high of product_weight_g, package_weight_g, package_length_mm, package_width_mm, package_height_mm), approved_by, approved_at (YYYY-MM-DD), reliability (estimated_average: the weakest level), basis. Optional per row: plausible ({field: {min, max}}: a value outside is not taken); baselines, the operator's amounts for the parts of a set of like items in a container, all of them or no block: item_g (one item), container_g (the container), carton_g (the box and its packing), longest_item_mm (the longest item), length_margin_mm (the box's length over the longest item), sides_mm and sides_with_container_mm (the box's [width, height] without the container and with it), approved_by, approved_at, basis (where each amount comes from). With the block a field the seller does not state is composed from the set's parts, each part from the product's own data when it is there and from the baseline when it is not (product weight = items + container; package weight = product weight + carton_g; package length = longest item + length_margin_mm; width and height = the sides), and the fields' flat averages are the last resort, used when the number of items or the container's state cannot be told; without the block a field is the seller's statement or the flat average. A new or changed row raises version. Optional too: kinds ([{kind, match, alone, always, unless, strong, lofts, fields, basis}]: a kind of product with its own low / central / high, package_measures.default_kind; lofts [min, max]: the variant's own value names that many distinct lofts); compose_by_count (50002783, 2026-11-17: a set's product weight = the clubs' labelled weights summed, or one labelled club weight x the set's count; item_g, writes, confidence, count_from, skip, approved_by, approved_at, basis; description_measures.compose_by_count). Version 7 (2026-11-17): plausible bands of 50002783 and 50002787, kinds two_wedges and four_plus and compose_by_count of 50002783.

basis.item_g: One club: the median of the sellers' club weight tables (332 g) over the 120 collected sets.
basis.container_g: The bag: the median of the 11 bag weights sellers state (2.6-4.8 kg).
basis.carton_g: A Callaway Edge 10-club set: clubs 3.7 kg, boxed 6 kg.
basis.longest_item_mm: The driver, when its length is not read (the 118 stated drivers are 1105-1168 mm).
basis.length_margin_mm: The one stated box, 121 cm, against its 111 cm driver.
basis.sides_mm: Without a bag: that stated box, 20 x 16 cm.
basis.sides_with_container_mm: With a bag: the caddie bags stated on 4 sets, 39-40 x 31 cm.
basis.certainty: Low: approximate until the first real shipment (the owner, 2026-11-10).

rows.basis: Median (central) and about the 10th / 90th percentile (low / high) of the naver-harvester's AI estimates on the 55 fairwardgolf full sets that have one in Shopify (read 2026-11-05; none seller-stated; sets with and without a bag together).

Two junior clubs (or a club and a glove) in one box, 2종 / 2개 / 2pcs with no bag and no larger count (8457258079, 2026-11-11: a #7 iron and a putter took the set's box, $799). kinds.basis: One wedge in its own box. Central 96 x 11 x 8 cm, 1 kg: the agent's estimate from the listing of 2026-11-15 (골프 웨지 세트, single wedges of 400-520 g), approved by the owner; low / high the agent's range. Single wedges are left out by the title screen (listing_title_rules.json, 50002783 single); this kind is for a variant that sells one wedge of a set-or-single listing (단품, 개별, 싱글, 낱개 in the variant), or 단품 in the title with no set word.

Two wedges in a carton. Central 98 x 15 x 10 cm, 1.7 kg (2 x 460 g = 920 g + the base row's 800 g carton): the agent from the data 2026-11-17 (research/wedge-fix-plan decisions.md C16-b), on the owner's delegation. 920: the median of the labelled 2-wedge sets is 895 g; low 760 Maruman AW + SW 765 g; high 1100 Yamato 2-pack 1.11 kg (13406052242). Width 15 cm: the p90 width of the measured 3-wedge boxes (17.8) less one head; height 10 cm the base row's (p90 10.2). The variant's own count (2개 / 2종 / 2P / 2pcs / 2피스 / 2자루 / 2본) or exactly two distinct lofts in its value; else the title's count when the listing has one variant or every variant names as many lofts; never with a count of 3 or more, 단품 / 개별 / 싱글 / 낱개 or a bag. In doubt the base row's 3-wedge box (the owner, 2026-11-11: the larger box).

Four to six wedges in the base row's carton (98 x 20 x 10 cm: the two measured 4-wedge boxes, 3.02 and 3.12 kg volumetric, fit it), 2.65 kg (4 x 460 g = 1840 g + 800 g carton; high 6 x 460): the agent from the data 2026-11-17 (research/wedge-fix-plan decisions.md C16-c), on the owner's delegation. The variant's own count (4-6개 / 종 / pcs / piece / wedges) or 4-6 distinct lofts in its value; else the title's count as for two_wedges; never the title's list of lofts (PGM 13017332771: 8 lofts in the title, variants of 3). The price does not move: 2.65 kg is under the box's 3.92 kg volumetric weight.

Central 98 x 20 x 10 cm, 2.2 kg (wedges about 460 g each: 3 x 460 = 1.4 kg): the agent's estimate from the listing of 2026-11-15 (골프 웨지 세트, 670 titles, sets of 2-6 wedges, median 226,000 KRW, many agency imports), approved by the owner (at level 1: $419 for 100,000 KRW, $579 for 225,000 KRW); low / high the agent's range. Kinds two_wedges and four_plus and compose_by_count: 2026-11-17, the same delegation.

compose_by_count.basis: A wedge set weighs its clubs, about 460 g each, no constant part: the labelled 2-wedge sets 765-920 g (median 895), the 3-wedge 1344-1440 g (median 1385); BombTech 3 x 480 = 1440 g against the stated 1430 / 1450 g. A product weight the seller does not state: the clubs' labelled weights (380-520 g each, a weight label and no part word) summed when there are as many as the set's clubs (confidence 3: USPA 414 + 412, Maruman 380 + 385), else one labelled weight x the count (2: PRGR 448, Toho 460, PGM 462). The count: the variant's own, else the title's when it states one. Not on a #7 / #5 reference or 기준 / 추정 / 상정 (Yamaha RMX, FITTAS), Amazon's Item Weight / Product weight (GoSports 424 g for a set), more weights than clubs (MG5, RMX 2021 and Honma NX tables), men's and women's weights in one listing, a title listing more lofts than any variant, a held product or a single club's variant. Only product_weight_g: the package and its sides stay (PGM 8 lofts x 462 g would have raised a box). The agent from the data 2026-11-17 (research/wedge-fix-plan decisions.md C17), on the owner's delegation.
